text:
Robert Thomas has three goals in 18 games, which is not why the Blues pay him. His chances are thin too (4.1 expected goals), and his shooting at 12.5% is a few points under his usual. Meanwhile St. Louis has scored 6.3 more goals than expected with him on, so his 14 points are, if anything, propped up.

That's the worrying version. The hopeful one is last season, when Evolving-Hockey had him 20th of 401 forwards in wins above replacement and in the 92nd percentile for driving offense. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking loved his puck work: 79% of his exits with possession and a top-tier setup rate.

He has a power-play goal and a shorthanded goal recently, and Yahoo Sports made the case for reuniting him with Jimmy Snuggerud and Dylan Holloway. Our range has him at 63 to 91 points, which assumes the chances come back.
